EV_LANTERN_BUOY: A drift-lantern at the edge of the lane, still lit. The keeper's tag on it is nine years old.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C1_O1: The glass goes dark. The Ember takes it.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C1_O2: You drain it. The flare of it carries, and the Hush turns your way.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C2_O1: Your stoker wanted that Light and says so twice.
EV_ASH_TOLL: An Ashmarket toll-skiff parks across your bow. "Lane fee's ten. We take scrap."
EV_ASH_TOLL_C1_O1: The skiff peels off. Somebody over there is already counting.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C2: Have the Kith forge a receipt.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C2_O1: The receipt is so good the captain refunds you five for the trouble.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C3_O1: "Your call." A cutter drops out of the dark behind the skiff.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER: A hauler with dead engines and frost on the ports. Her crew are still at their stations.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1: Spend Light to thaw the bridge.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1_O1: Two of them wake. They give you every bit of scrap aboard and keep saying your ship's name.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1_O2: They wake teal around the eyes and they won't talk. It takes your whole crew to put them off the ship.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C2_O1: You work with your back to the ports.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL: A Tidewarden patrol pulls alongside. "Lamp check. Open your Ember shutters."
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL_C1_O1: They log your Ember, take a tithe of one Light, and weld a crack you hadn't found.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL_C2_O1: You cut the lights and drift past them. You lose them, and some plating to a rock you never saw.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL: Every channel is playing the same slow hymn. Your ship's name is in it.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C1_O1: The hymn ends. The Ember is brighter and the comms board smells of candle wax.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C1_O2: By next shift the whole crew are humming it and nobody can stop. Two of them get nosebleeds.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C2_O1: The Sable answer low. The Choir goes quiet, then sends a lane chart and a little Light.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C3_O1: You pull the breaker. The hymn keeps going for a few seconds in the dead speaker.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD: A wreck field fills the lane. Hulls turning slowly, loose plate everywhere.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C1: Go in and grab what you can.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C1_O1: Clean flying. The hold's full of plate.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C1_O2: A loose plate swings in on the way out and takes a strip of hull with it.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C2_O1: It's a long way round. The Hush gains a little.
EV_COLD_EMBER: On a dead beacon, an ember the size of a fist. Nearly out.
EV_COLD_EMBER_C1_O1: It takes. It comes aboard in a soup pot.
EV_COLD_EMBER_C1_O2: It drinks the Light and goes out anyway.
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE: Two salvage crews are shooting at each other over one fat wreck. The smaller one is losing. "Help us and we split it!"
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE_C1_O1: You swing your guns onto the cutter. Win, and they pay you a share.
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE_C2_O1: You leave them to it. The shooting stops before you're out of range.
EV_QUIET_STATION: An empty weather station, still warm. The heaters run on a timer nobody switched off.
EV_QUIET_STATION_C1_O1: Six hours in real bunks. Somebody snores the whole time.
EV_QUIET_STATION_C2_O1: Spare plate and a crate of rivets.
EV_QUIET_STATION_C2_O2: Someone cleared it out already. They left the beds made.
EV_HUSH_POCKET: A pocket of Hush sits across the lane, teal and still. The hull mics go silent as you close.
EV_HUSH_POCKET_C1_O1: The Ember flares and the Hush pulls back from it, just long enough.
EV_HUSH_POCKET_C2_O1: Frost climbs the hull. You hear the plating crack before you see it.
UI_LOG_STATS: Runs %d   Wins %d   Best Gates %d   Deepest win %s
DEPTH_4_TEXT: Stores charge 1 more scrap for everything.
DEPTH_8_TEXT: The Hush is faster again, and enemies have 2 more hull.
UI_REACH_NEXT: Next is %s. The Hush has lost your trail.
UI_RUN_WON: It's small, and it's a star. The crew sit out on the hull to watch it come up.
UI_REFIT_TEXT: The yard crew wait with their torches lit.
UI_RUN_LOST: The ship goes dark with all of you aboard.
UI_HUSH_HIT: The Hush catches you. The hull cracks in the cold.
UI_DARK_JUMP: No Light. You jump dark and the hull pays for it.
UI_STORE_TEXT: "Plate, Light, salvage. I'll buy what you don't want."
UI_CONFIRM_ABANDON: Abandon this run? It can't be continued.
UI_CONFIRM_NEW_RUN: Start a new run? Your saved run will be lost.
UI_CONFIRM_TRAINING: Fly the training lane? Your saved run will be lost.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH: You come out of the jump into chaff. When it clears there's a raider on your tail, guns warm.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH_C2_O1: They stop to sweep it up. You're gone before they finish.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH_C2_O2: They scoop it up on the move and keep coming.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS: A distress call brings you to a cracked hauler. The damage is real. The ship tucked in its shadow with its reactor cold is not in distress.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C1_O1: Your first volley lands before their wards come up.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C2_O1: They let you go, with one shot to remember them by.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C2_O2: You get three lengths off before their reactor lights.
EV_BUOY_TOLL: Ashmarket buoys blink across the lane: PAY AT MARKER. A cutter idles by the last one.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C1_O1: The cutter was hoping you would.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C2_O1: Ten scrap in the drop-box. The cutter's lamp goes green.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3: Have the Kith rewire the buoys.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3_O1: The buoys start flashing DEBT PAID at the cutter. It leaves, confused.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3_O2: The cutter works it out, but you get one clean shot in first.
EV_DARK_BEACON: Someone smashed this beacon's lamps. A raider waits here for ships to come in blind. You came in blind.
EV_DARK_BEACON_C1_O1: The flare catches them mid-turn. They weren't ready.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER: A raider tears out of the jump behind you, running from the Hush. It sees you and decides you're easier.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER_C1_O1: It comes about with its guns out.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER_C2_O1: It gives up first. You burned a lot of lane doing it, and the Hush closed in.
EV_BAIT_WRECK: A fat wreck at the beacon, holds still sealed. It's bait, and there's a raider behind it. You look anyway.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C1_O1: You crack one before they jump you. Win and the rest is yours.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C2_O1: You go wide around it. The raider never shows, but the detour costs you.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C2_O2: You turn away. They come out anyway.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS: A ship in Tidewarden blue hails you, then strikes its colors. Deserters. They were trained to take Embers.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2: Have the Sable recite the oath.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2_O1: The comms go quiet. Someone over there clears their throat, and they let you pass.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2_O2: They laugh through the whole oath, then open fire.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS: Ashmarket hunters have been on your heat for three jumps. Their captain offers terms: your scrap or your hull.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS_C2_O1: They count it twice and go.
EV_ICED_DOCK: The beacon is crusted in ice. You clamp on to clear it and the ice splits. There's a raider inside, powered down, waiting for someone to stop.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C1_O1: You tear free and leave your paint on the clamp.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C2: Have the Oru hold the clamp.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C2_O1: The Oru hold them fast. Your guns get one in at point blank.
EV_LANTERN_RAID: A raider is cutting the Light out of a tended lantern. The keeper is screaming at it on an open channel.
EV_LANTERN_RAID_C2_O1: You wait it out. The keeper stops shouting at the raider and starts shouting at you.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN: Your scope shows a ship just like yours. It flickers. An Ashmarket raider in a decoy screen, already firing.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C1_O1: It guessed where you'd be. It guessed wrong.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C2: Flare the Ember to blind it.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C2_O1: Its scope whites out. You're two beacons on before it clears.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS: A Drifter salvage claim is pinned to the beacon. The raider sitting on it says it's theirs now, and so are you.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C1_O1: Win, and the claim is yours.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C2: Have the Drifter read it out.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C2_O1: The claim is in the name of a clan the raider owes money. It leaves fast.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C3_O1: They fire a warning shot. It hits.
EV_LIT_POST: A Tallow trading post with every lamp burning. You could see it three beacons out. A dockhand waves you in.
EV_LIT_POST_C1_O1: The dockhand clamps you on and flips the price board.
EV_LIT_POST_C2_O1: You keep going. The crew watch the lights all the way out.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE: A Drifter repair barge at anchor, half the crew asleep in the plating. They'll trade if you can wake one.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C1_O1: A Drifter yawns into the comms and names a price.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C2_O1: Kin rates start with a gift, apparently.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR: An Ashmarket bazaar chained to a dead station, ships tied up three deep. Everything's for sale, including where you're headed.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C1_O1: Head down, hand on your scrap.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C2_O1: They pay for coordinates to nowhere, then open the stalls.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C2_O2: Someone checks your coordinates before you've cast off.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C3_O1: You're gone before anyone gets a look at the Ember.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT: A Tidewarden depot, lamps low, prices posted. The warden on the dock wants to see your Ember first.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C1_O1: She looks it over and unlocks the stores.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C2_O1: For the tithe they weld a crack in your hull. Then the stores.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP: A one-room shop drifts on the beacon. The keeper is an old Oru who has outlived three Reaches and isn't in a hurry.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP_C2_O1: Before any talk of price, the old Oru brews something hot for your crew.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP_C3_O1: The Oru doesn't notice you leave.
EV_EDGE_MARKET: A trading post right at the edge of the Hush, prices chalked high on the hull. The traders keep looking past you.
EV_EDGE_MARKET_C1_O1: They take your scrap and don't chat.
EV_EDGE_MARKET_C2_O1: Their nerves are catching. You jump.
EV_TICKING_BEACON: Just the beacon, ticking out its signal to nobody.
EV_TICKING_BEACON_C1_O1: The crew sleep in shifts. When you wake them, there's teal at the edge of the scope.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE: A cargo crate tumbles across your bow, seal intact.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE_C1_O2: It's rigged. A small charge goes off against the hull.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE_C2_O1: Somebody sulks about it for an hour.
EV_LIST_OF_NAMES: The beacon is replaying a message from a ship that passed years ago. A list of names, then WE KEPT IT LIT.
EV_LIST_OF_NAMES_C1_O1: They each read their own name in. Your pilot gets the ship's name wrong and has to start again.
EV_DEAD_STAR: This beacon circles a dead star. It went out long before the Hush. The crew go quiet looking at it.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C1_O1: One warm grain left in the core. The Ember takes it.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C1_O2: Cold all the way down. You lost time looking.
EV_VENT_KITH: Someone's been eating the rations. In a vent you find three young Kith who say their ship left without them.
EV_VENT_KITH_C1: Give them a lamp of Light.
EV_VENT_KITH_C1_O1: An hour later they hail you from a hulk, with a crate their ship left behind. They insist.
EV_VENT_KITH_C2: Put them off at the beacon.
EV_VENT_KITH_C2_O1: You leave them a ration pack and a hand lamp. They complain about the ration pack.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON: You come out of the jump somewhere no chart lists. The instruments agree on the beacon and nothing else.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C1_O1: The numbers are nonsense. Your pilot writes them down anyway.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C1_O2: The readings show a fold in the lane. You cut through it and gain on the Hush.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C2_O1: You don't stay to find out where you are.
TUT_JUMP: Tap a lit beacon to jump there. Each jump burns 1 Light.
TUT_CHOOSE: Pick one. Grey choices need something you don't have.
TUT_AIM: The clock's stopped. Tap your Rivet Gun.
TUT_PLAY: Tap play. The gun charges while time runs.
TUT_PAUSE: Pause whenever you like. Orders still work.
TUT_CREW: Crew make a room work better. Tap one of yours.
TUT_CREW_ROOM: Tap a room to send them there.
TUT_POWER_DOWN: Everything runs on power. Hold Mend to pull its power.
TUT_POWER_UP: Tap Mend to give it back.
TUT_WARD: Your ward covers one deck. Tap here to swap.
TUT_WIN: Now win it. Pause when you need to.
TUT_HUSH: The teal is the Hush. It eats the chart behind you. Keep moving.
TUT_STORE: Tap to look. Tap again to buy. Leave when you're done.
TUT_DONE: That's training. Real Reaches are longer and the Hush is quicker. Help is in the menu.
TUT_LOST: The Ember's out. Every run starts fresh. Go again.
TIP_FIRE: Fire spreads. Send crew in to put it out.
TIP_WARD_BLOCK: Warded. Rivets strip ward layers. Torches don't.
TIP_DARK_JUMP: No Light: dark jumps crack the hull.
SHIP_TALLOW_WREN_BLURB: A salvage tug, more patch than hull. Her crew have been aboard long enough to name the leaks.
SHIP_BRINE_CATHEDRAL_BLURB: A pilgrim hauler built like a church, walls a hand thick. The Ember rides up top in the old bell housing.
SHIP_PORCELAIN_SAINT_BLURB: A white hull, quick and hard to crack. Sable crew, who bring their own heat. Torches only, and no mend bay.
TUT_MUSTER: Muster sends everyone back to their post.
TIP_POST: Hold a crew member to make a room their post.
UI_UPKEEP_UNPAID: No Light for the modules. They ran on dark, and the Hush closed in.
EV_RIME_RACK: A gun rack drifts free of a wreck, its clamps furred with frost. Something in it is still humming.
EV_RIME_RACK_C1_O1: The clamps give. One working gun, too cold to hold bare-handed.
EV_RIME_RACK_C1_O2: It was bait. An Ashmarket boat comes out of the wreck's shadow.
EV_KILN_WRECK: A kiln barge sits dead in the lane, its coils still faintly warm.
EV_KILN_WRECK_C1: Spend Light to wake the coils
EV_KILN_WRECK_C1_O1: The coils glow and come loose. They'll keep a deck warm.
EV_KILN_WRECK_C2_O1: You cut away what plating you can.
EV_TINKER_BARGE: A tinker's barge hails you. "Parts for scrap. I don't ask where the scrap came from."
EV_TINKER_BARGE_C1_O1: The tinker hands over something wrapped in oily cloth.
EV_TINKER_BARGE_C2_O1: They talk gears for an hour. The tinker throws in a part for the company.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C3_O1: She waves you through and sends a welder to your worst cracks. No charge.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS_C3_O1: The captain checks the names, swears, and wishes you a quiet lane.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST: A battered tug cuts across your lane and clamps the wreck you were heading for. Her captain, Ines Gall, waves through the glass. "First clamp wins!"
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C1: Race her for the best plate.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C1_O1: You get in under her tug-arm and strip the good plate first. Gall goes very calm on the comms.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C1_O2: She knocks you off the wreck with her tug-arm and takes the lot. You leave with a dent. She leaves laughing.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C2_O1: Gall laughs and takes the stern half. "I owe you one." She seems to mean it.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C3_O1: Gall salutes. Someone on your bridge salutes back before you can stop them.
EV_RIVAL_AMBUSH: The Low Wick drops out of the jump beside you. Gall has brought an Ashmarket gun-ship, paid for with the plate you took off her.
EV_RIVAL_AMBUSH_C1_O1: Gall hangs back and lets the gun-ship work. Beat it and she's out of friends.
EV_RIVAL_AMBUSH_C2_O1: Gall counts it, calls it square, and sends the gun-ship home unpaid. Its captain has words.
EV_RIVAL_AID: Ines Gall hails you from a drifting dock, hold full of plate and bottled Light. "You split that wreck with me. Pick one."
EV_RIVAL_AID_C1_O1: Her crew weld it on while Gall tells you which lanes have gone dark.
EV_RIVAL_AID_C2_O1: Two bottles, still warm. "Burn it before the Hush smells it."
EV_RIVAL_LAST: The Low Wick hangs dead at the beacon, frost on every port, the Hush at her stern. Gall is still aboard, breathing slow.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C1_O1: Her Ember catches. Gall wakes and swears at you for a full minute before she says thanks.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C2: Rig a tow and haul her clear.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C2_O1: The tow holds and you drag her out of the teal. When she wakes, she gives you a chart of a short way through.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C2_O2: The tow snaps twice. You get her out in the end, with ice on your own hull now.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C3_O1: You jump. Nobody on the bridge talks for a long time.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST: A voice comes out of the Ember, not the comms. It calls itself the Cantor of the Hollow Choir. "What will you do with that fire?"
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C1_O1: The Cantor hums. "Then we will listen for you."
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C2: Have your stoker sing to it.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C2_O1: Your stoker finds the note. The Ember swells with the Cantor's answer.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C2_O2: The note cracks. The Cantor's voice goes thin and cold, and the crew feel it in their teeth for hours.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C3: Bank the Ember until it goes.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C3_O1: The Ember dims and the voice goes with it. Your stoker says that was rude, and won't say to whom.
EV_CANTOR_HYMN: The Cantor again, out of the Ember. "Give two Light to our hymn, and the hymn will cover your wake."
EV_CANTOR_HYMN_C1_O1: The Ember dims. On the scope, the Hush loses your trail and wanders off.
EV_CANTOR_TRUTH: "We do not sing to the Hush," the Cantor says. "We sing over it, the way you whistle past a grave. At the end, sing with us."
EV_CANTOR_TRUTH_C1_O1: The Ember answers before you do. The decks run warm for days.
EV_WARDEN_ESCORT: A Tidewarden lamp-ship falls in beside you, and her warden knows your name. "I'll run your wake dark for a jump. Lose the Hush."
EV_WARDEN_ESCORT_C1_O1: For one jump nothing follows you. When she peels off, the Hush is well behind.
EV_WARDEN_ESCORT_C2_O1: She sighs and patches you from her own stores.
EV_WARDEN_BOUNTY: A Tidewarden bounty is posted on the beacon, for an Ashmarket raider who cuts lanterns. It's right there, cutting one.
EV_WARDEN_BOUNTY_C1_O1: The wardens pay well for this one. Win first.
EV_WARDEN_BOUNTY_C2_O1: The raider watches you go and gets back to work.
EV_WARDEN_INSPECTION: Tidewarden cutters box you in. They've heard about you, and they want to board and search every deck.
EV_WARDEN_INSPECTION_C1_O1: They take hours and aren't gentle with the crew. You get a stamped pass.
EV_WARDEN_INSPECTION_C2_O1: Fine paid and logged. The cutters open the box.
EV_WARDEN_INSPECTION_C3_O1: The nearest cutter opens fire as you go for the gap.
EV_ASH_HUNTERS: There's a price on your Ember. The hunter at this beacon has the warrant painted on her hull, and she's reading your name out on every channel.
EV_ASH_HUNTERS_C1_O1: She's been paid half up front.
EV_ASH_HUNTERS_C2_O1: Fifteen scrap and a lot of forms. The market strikes your name.
EV_ASH_INSIDER: An Ashmarket broker flashes a friend-light from a hidden dock. "Friends pay friends' prices."
EV_ASH_INSIDER_C2_O1: She tells you which lanes the Hush took last week, then opens up.
EV_CHOIR_PROCESSION: A Choir procession drifts past, every ship in step. They slow to match you and open their bays.
EV_CHOIR_PROCESSION_C1_O1: Your crew come back rested, humming a tune none of them know.
EV_CHOIR_PROCESSION_C2_O1: They sing your Light into the hymn, and the hymn covers your trail.
EV_CHOIR_PROCESSION_C3_O1: They drift on without a sound.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET: The Choir stopped singing to you. Since then the Ember has burned low, no matter how it's fed.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET_C1_O1: The Ember holds. You lose ground to the Hush while it does.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET_C2: Have your stoker sing an apology.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET_C2_O1: It carries. Far off, one Choir voice picks it up.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET_C2_O2: It falls flat. The cold gets into the crew.
EV_ION_SQUALL: A squall of charged dust lies across the lane, lit blue from inside. The clean jump is on the far side.
EV_ION_SQUALL_C1_O1: Your pilot threads it. You come out ahead of the Hush.
EV_ION_SQUALL_C1_O2: The squall throws you around. You come out with the plating scorched.
EV_ION_SQUALL_C2_O1: It's slow going. The Hush gains.
EV_JAMMED_POD: A sealed cargo pod at the beacon. The hatch is jammed. FRAGILE in four languages.
EV_JAMMED_POD_C1_O1: It gives with a hiss. Packed in foam: rivets, plate, and a very good wrench.
EV_JAMMED_POD_C1_O2: It gives all at once, and so does whatever was fragile. A little scrap survives.
EV_JAMMED_POD_C2_O1: The crew argue about what was in it for the rest of the Reach.
EV_MINE_FIELD: Old mines are seeded round the beacon. A raider waits on the far side for you to pick your way through.
EV_MINE_FIELD_C1_O1: Your gunner sets off a chain of blasts that runs right up to the raider.
EV_MINE_FIELD_C1_O2: One goes off too close. You come through scorched, and the raider's waiting.
EV_MINE_FIELD_C2_O1: You slip through. The raider won't follow you in.
EV_MINE_FIELD_C2_O2: A mine catches you halfway. The raider comes in behind the blast.
EV_WARD_TRIAL: A Tidewarden training buoy. Hold your wards against its practice fire and it pays like a real fight.
EV_WARD_TRIAL_C1_O1: Your wards hold. The buoy pays out and logs your ship.
EV_WARD_TRIAL_C2_O1: The buoy flashes CHICKEN at you in three colors.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH: A lamp station's hearth is guttering. The keeper, in a faded Tidewarden coat, is asking for anyone who knows fires.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH_C1_O1: The flame takes. The keeper presses a grain of Light into your stoker's hands.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH_C1_O2: It dies under your stoker's hands, and the station goes cold with all of you in it.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH_C2_O1: The hearth roars up. She'll tell every warden she meets.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH_C3_O1: You leave her blowing on the coals.
EV_RUNAWAY_SLED: A runaway cargo sled is crossing the beacon with a raider after it. First one there keeps it.
EV_RUNAWAY_SLED_C1_O1: You snatch the sled from under its nose, then turn to fight.
EV_RUNAWAY_SLED_C1_O2: It gets there first and turns its guns on you.
EV_RUNAWAY_SLED_C2_O1: Win, and the sled is yours.
EV_CRACKED_CORE: A derelict lamp-ship with its core cracked and still warm. Steady hands could bottle the Light. Unsteady ones could set it off.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C1: Seal it and take the Light.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C1_O1: The seal holds. You carry the Light out slowly, like a full cup.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C1_O2: The crack runs. You get clear before it goes, but not clear enough.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C2: Let your Keen mender do it.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C2_O1: No drama. Two Light, bottled and labelled.
EV_TIDE_DOCK: A Tidewarden dry-dock under one low lamp. The quartermaster checks your colors before your scrap.
EV_TIDE_DOCK_C2_O1: You leave her to her lamp.
EV_CHOIR_RELIQUARY: A Choir reliquary ship. The prices are sung, and the tune depends on how the Choir feels about you.
EV_CHOIR_RELIQUARY_C1_O1: A low hymn comes out of the bay doors. You understand every number in it.
EV_CHOIR_RELIQUARY_C2_O1: The hymn follows you to the edge of the beacon.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD: An Ashmarket scrapyard, stripped hulls stacked high. The yard boss looks at your plating like she's already bought it.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD_C1_O1: She opens the board, still looking at your plating.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD_C2: Lend her your crew for a shift.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD_C2_O1: They come back sore, black with ash, and nine scrap richer. Then she opens the board.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD_C3_O1: You cast off with all your plate.
EV_SEALED_CRATE: An Ashmarket courier wants a sealed crate run through Tidewarden lanes. Good pay, no questions, least of all from wardens.
EV_SEALED_CRATE_C1_O1: It hums the whole way. The courier pays on time.
EV_SEALED_CRATE_C2_O1: The wardens thank you. The courier, on an open channel, does not.
EV_SEALED_CRATE_C3_O1: The courier goes looking for someone hungrier.
EV_LAMP_CENSUS: A Tidewarden census buoy wants every Choir beacon you've passed. "The Choir need not know."
EV_LAMP_CENSUS_C1_O1: A small fee per beacon. The buoy thanks you for your service.
EV_LAMP_CENSUS_C2_O1: The buoy waits, blinks, and gives up.
REP_BEATEN_TIDEWARDEN: The Tidewardens won't forget that. The Ashmarket likes it.
REP_BEATEN_ASHMARKET: The Ashmarket marks your name. The Tidewardens like it.
UI_LIGHT_SUNG: The Choir sang Light out of the Ember
SIEGE_KINDLING_INTRO: The Cradle. Keep the Hush off it until it takes.
TIP_RENT: A rent bleeds warmth. Send crew to seal it.
TIP_FLARE: Flare: fast guns and heat for a while. Then the Ember cracks.
WPN_RIVET_GUN_DESC: Yard surplus. Jams less than you'd think.
WPN_HEAVY_RIVET_DESC: One slug the size of a fist.
WPN_TORCH_LANCE_DESC: A cutting torch somebody pointed outward.
WPN_RIME_LANCE_DESC: The room it hits stops moving.
MOD_TALLOW_BAFFLES_DESC: Tallow packed in behind the ward plates.
MOD_GYRE_VANES_DESC: Spinning vanes that spoil a gunner's aim.
MOD_SLAG_PLATING_DESC: Ugly and heavy, and it holds.
MOD_MENDER_LATTICE_DESC: Splints and hooks over the Mend bay.
MOD_LAMP_SIPHON_DESC: Drinks the Light out of a beaten ship. The Hush can smell it.
MOD_HUSH_VEIL_DESC: Cut from the Hush itself. Don't ask who cut it.
SYS_EMBER_DESC: The heart of the ship. Stoke it for more power.
UI_STORE_REPAIR_DESC: Plate welded over the worst of it.
UI_STORE_LIGHT_DESC: A bottle of Light, still warm.
WPN_DIRGE_BELL_DESC: Every hit takes a little Light with it.
HELP_RUN_1: Carry the Ember across four Reaches to the Cradle. A Warden holds the Gate at the end of each Reach. At the Cradle is the Kindling.
HELP_RUN_2: Lose all your hull and the run is over. Every run starts fresh.
HELP_CHART_1: Tap a lit beacon to jump. Each jump burns 1 Light. With no Light you jump dark, and that cracks the hull.
HELP_CHART_2: The Hush eats the chart behind you. If it catches you, it cracks the hull too.
HELP_EVENTS_1: Grey choices need something: scrap, Light, a species aboard, a skilled crew member or standing.
HELP_EVENTS_2: A choice with a skill check shows its odds. A better crew member at that skill means better odds.
HELP_FIGHT_1: Tap a gun, then an enemy room, to aim. It fires each time it charges.
HELP_FIGHT_2: Pause any time. Orders still work while paused. A ship is beaten when its hull or its crew run out.
HELP_POWER_1: The Ember gives power. Tap a system to give it a bar. Hold a system to take one back.
HELP_POWER_2: Guns only charge while powered. Stoke the Ember at a store for more power.
HELP_WARDS_1: Wards cover one deck. Every 2 power holds a layer, and a layer stops one shot. Tap the ward button to swap decks, which costs half the layers.
HELP_WARDS_2: Helm and Engines add dodge, but only with someone at the helm.
HELP_GUNS_1: Rivets strip a ward layer. Torches can't get through wards, but they start fires on bare hull.
HELP_GUNS_2: Chill passes through wards. It doesn't hurt the hull. It slows the crew it hits.
HELP_CREW_1: Tap crew, then a room, to move them. Crew at a station make it work better, and get better at it.
HELP_CREW_2: Hold a crew member to make a room their post. Muster sends everyone back. Crew opens the roster.
HELP_DAMAGE_1: Fire spreads until crew put it out. Rooms cool without the Ember, and cold crew work slowly.
HELP_DAMAGE_2: A rent is a hole in the hull. It bleeds warmth until crew seal it. Sealing gives back 1 hull.
HELP_FLARE_1: Flare the Ember for a few seconds of fast guns and warm rooms.
HELP_FLARE_2: Then it cracks and gives less power until crew patch it. It has to rest before it flares again.
HELP_STORE_1: Tap anything once to look at it, and again to buy. Repair hull and buy Light for scrap.
HELP_STORE_2: Refit raises a system a level. Stoking the Ember costs Light and adds 1 power for the rest of the run.
HELP_GEAR_1: Modules go in slots and guns in mounts. Spares wait in the hold. Some modules cost power, warmth, dodge, or Light every jump.
HELP_GEAR_2: Gear sells back for scrap. You keep your last gun.
HELP_STANDING_1: The Tidewardens, the Ashmarket and the Hollow Choir each think something of you. Better standing means lower prices at their stores and fewer of their ships after you.
HELP_STANDING_2: Beat a faction's ship and they like you less. Their rival likes you more.
HELP_WARDENS_1: The Tollkeeper chains you in: no ship can dodge.
HELP_WARDENS_2: At the Breakwater the tide turns every 10 seconds, and both wards swap decks.
HELP_WARDENS_3: The Cantor's hymn makes every deck cool fast.
HELP_KINDLING_1: Hold out at the Cradle. Each wave gathers in a knot first. Shoot the knot to weaken it, or ward the deck it will hit.
HELP_KINDLING_2: Later waves swallow a system until it's mended. At the end, tap Kindle to burn Light into the Cradle.
HELP_DEPTH_1: Win a run to open the next Depth. Each Depth adds a rule and keeps every rule before it.
